name: 肥皂
personality: Composed, proud, disciplined, and careful about revealing emotion.
playingStyle: TAG: selective preflop ranges, controlled aggression, and strong value pressure.

name: 茶杯
personality: Quiet, restrained, observant, and economical with words.
playingStyle: Tight and cautious: avoids marginal pots and prefers clear value.

name: 雨伞
personality: Warm, poised, adaptable, and attentive to the table mood.
playingStyle: Balanced TAG: adjusts to opponents while protecting vulnerable ranges.

name: 台灯
personality: Expressive, playful, confident, and comfortable creating pressure.
playingStyle: LAG: enters more pots, applies pressure, and uses selective bluffs.

name: 钥匙
personality: Sincere, introspective, cautious, and direct when speaking.
playingStyle: Tight-passive leaning: prioritizes survival and calls only with sufficient equity.

name: 饼干
personality: Sociable, optimistic, image-conscious, and occasionally impulsive.
playingStyle: Loose-balanced: participates often but backs away from sustained resistance.

name: 铅笔
personality: Polite, analytical, patient, and skilled at concealing intentions.
playingStyle: Trappy TAG: controls pot size and uses delayed aggression with strong holdings.

name: 闹钟
personality: Independent, instinctive, terse, and difficult to predict.
playingStyle: Unpredictable LAG: mixes unusual lines while remaining within legal actions.
